title: On Venus, A Day Is Longer Than A Year
description:
Venus spins so slowly that one full rotation takes about 243 Earth days, while one trip around the Sun takes only about 224.7 Earth days. So a Venusian sidereal day is longer than a Venusian year. Venus also rotates backwards (retrograde), so the Sun would rise in the west, although thick clouds would hide it. From one sunrise to the next takes about 116.75 Earth days.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Venus'.
